description: Frontier HPC and Facility Data publishes waste-heat observations from an Oak Ridge National Laboratory high-performance computing data centre. The Figshare deposit by the ORNL research team is intended to support research on recovering heat from large computing facilities. Version 4 contains one Excel workbook and states CC BY 4.0, allowing free access and reuse with attribution. Its own landing-page description does not provide a variable dictionary, complete observation period or sampling resolution; those details require the linked descriptor and the workbook documentation. The workbook itself was not downloaded in this metadata review. Coverage is one computing facility, so its thermal behaviour should not be assumed to represent conventional enterprise data centres. The resource can inform heat-recovery, cooling and coupled electricity-and-heat simulations, with assumptions about equipment and operating conditions made explicit. It relates to platform-exadigit for data-centre modelling and data-cineca-marconi-examon-telemetry for a separate facility's operational telemetry. No compatibility with either resource was tested.
